verdict.summary: Assessed critical, driven by: Injected / forged Received hop; DMARC fail with strict alignment; Homoglyph / lookalike of a protected brand.

contributions.label: Injected / forged Received hop
contributions.rationale: Deliberate deception. Near-zero false positive rate.

detail.explanation: Private address in a public relay chain; hop was injected before transmission.

contributions.label: DMARC fail with strict alignment

contributions.label: Homoglyph / lookalike of a protected brand
contributions.rationale: There is no legitimate reason to register a confusable domain.

contributions.label: Attachment hash flagged malicious
contributions.rationale: External corroboration on a concrete artifact.

contributions.label: Reply-To domain differs from From domain
contributions.rationale: Core BEC mechanic: reply diversion to an attacker-controlled inbox.

contributions.label: Sender domain registered less than 30 days ago
contributions.rationale: Phishing infrastructure is disposable, and therefore young.

contributions.label: Payment-diversion intent detected
